summary: Iteration 108 verification — multi-model AI comparison is now correctly gated to PAID/UNLIMITED workspaces on backend + web + mobile. Backend pytest suite (5/5 PASS) confirms: (1) /api/billing/usage and /api/billing/me expose comparison_allowed=false for FREE mate1@test.io and true for UNLIMITED sam@funasia.net; (2) POST /api/ai/research with 3 selected_models by a free user is silently capped to 1 model AND still returns a synthesized final_answer; (3) POST /api/ai/research/{id}/run-models by a free user returns 402 with detail.code='comparison_paid_only'; (4) same call by sam succeeds (200) and adds the extra model to thread.selected_models. WEB (desktop 1440x900): free user's AI composer picker shows [data-testid=compare-upgrade-banner] + [data-testid=compare-upgrade-btn] instead of model-toggle chips (0 chips), and the AI answer bubble button label is 'Upgrade to compare' which navigates to /billing on click; UNLIMITED user sees 9 model-toggle chips, no upgrade banner, and NO duplicate ai_question bubbles (MessageList filter working). MOBILE (390x844 via Expo web preview): FREE user's Research tab shows [testID=research-upgrade-banner] + [testID=research-upgrade-btn] with copy 'Comparing multiple AI models is a Pro feature.' + Upgrade button, and chips render as single-select (only ChatGPT 5.5 preselected); mobile login regression PASSED — sam@funasia.net / Perfect$2008 signs in successfully and [testID=login-toggle-password] exists and toggles the password visibility. No mocked APIs were exercised in this run.

issues: A 'Credit specials' upsell modal auto-opens the first time Ask AI is clicked and covers the composer's compare-upgrade-banner until dismissed. Once dismissed (Maybe later), the banner and Upgrade-to-compare button render correctly. Consider deferring this modal so it does not stack on top of the composer's own paid-gate banner.

action_items: (Docs / spec drift only, not a bug) The review request cites mobile chip testIDs as 'research-model-chip-*' but /app/mobile/app/(tabs)/research.tsx:131 renders them as `model-chip-${m.key}`. Either update the docs or rename the testIDs to `research-model-chip-*` for parity with the review contract.

(Optional UX) Defer the /credits 'Credit specials' auto-upsell modal on free-plan Ask-AI opens so the composer's compare-upgrade-banner is visible on first paint (currently the modal covers it until dismissed).
critical_code_review_comments: backend/routes/ai.py:341-348 — run_models raises HTTPException(402, {code,message}). FastAPI wraps this as detail={'code':...,'message':...}. Verified free user parses correctly. OK.
backend/services/billing.py:447 — comparison_allowed = unlimited OR plan in {pro,team}. Correct per Option A (strict). No leak.
frontend/src/pages/Chats.jsx:975 — onOpenThread gate for free users routes to /billing instead of opening AIComparisonInline. Verified visually. OK.

mobile/app/(tabs)/research.tsx:48 — falls back to `allowed=true` when /api/billing/usage returns null/errors. This is a soft-fail that could over-grant compare access if the endpoint is briefly broken. Consider defaulting to `false` (block) instead of `true` for safety.

rca of the issue: No open bugs — verification only. All backend gates + web/mobile UI gates behave per the strict Option A spec. Duplicate ai_question bubble regression is also fixed on web (0 ai-question-bubble-* nodes rendered for the unlimited user's inline comparison view).
